rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance – Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: The Rent Board sets the allowable annual rent increase for rent-controlled units each March 1 – February 28 period. For March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 the allowed increase is 1.6%.
rules.citation: Rent Ordinance (Rent Board allowable annual increases)
rules.quoted_span:
Allowable Rent Increase:
1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

rules.title: San Francisco Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits at the rate set annually by the Rent Board. For March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 the rate is 4.2%.
rules.citation: Rent Board Security Deposit Interest Rates
rules.quoted_span:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C and 37.9A – Relocation Payments
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition, temporary capital improvement work or substantial rehabilitation must receive relocation payments. For notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27 the amount is $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly or disabled tenant or household with a minor child. Ellis Act evictions carry higher amounts ($11,110.05 per tenant, $33,330.13 maximum per unit, plus $7,443.90 per elderly or disabled tenant).
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant (max $24,733 per unit) for notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27

coverage.summary: Applies to tenants evicted for owner or relative move-in, demolition, capital improvement work, substantial rehabilitation, or under the Ellis Act.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 instead.
